data.title: Finding Y-Intercepts on the Coordinate Plane
data.description: Practice coordinate plane skills with Ordered pairs on the coordinate plane

challenges.instruction: Analyze the linear function passing through the given points. Determine the coordinate where the line intersects the y-axis.
challenges.hint: The y-intercept is the value of y when x is equal to 0.

challenges.instruction: Identify the y-intercept for the linear equation represented by the line passing through these coordinates.
challenges.hint: Evaluate the line's position as it crosses the vertical axis.

challenges.instruction: Find the point of intersection on the y-axis for the line defined by the given ordered pairs.
challenges.hint: Look for the b-value in the slope-intercept form y = mx + b.

challenges.instruction: Calculate or determine graphically where the linear function intersects the vertical y-axis.
challenges.hint: Substitute x = 0 into the equation or track the slope backward to the y-axis.

challenges.instruction: Determine the exact y-intercept value for the line passing through the specified points on the coordinate plane.
challenges.hint: The y-intercept occurs where the x-coordinate is 0.
